audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Katarina/Skill/Skill while content win[0..6] reads Akshan/Akshan/Katarina x5. Levels 1 and 2 in particular: the content layer and the packet both give them to Akshan, but phases[0].why and phases[1].why describe Katarina dictating the lane.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer. Pre-Shunpo Katarina has no gap closer against 850-range Avengerang and a three-hit Dirty Fighting proc that also shields him; from level 3 the 725-range blink erases the range gap, which is exactly what whys[2] says.
audit.corrected: phases[N].side aligned to the packet and content layer; phases[0].why and phases[1].why rewritten to state why Akshan owns those two levels.

audit.why: Level 3 (Shunpo online) is the real flip, level 6 Death Lotus against a 550-range marksman, first item one-rotation, and a late game where he has to stand and channel. Comeuppance is 100/85/70s and 2500 range; Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit and gave no sequencing (the packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'). Dirty Fighting's shield-on-third-hit was never stated even though it is what makes an even-HP all-in unfavourable. Going Rogue's camouflage was on the page as a roam threat but never as a vision requirement.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: every three hits from attacks and abilities deals bonus damage and shields him against a champion. Going Rogue puts him in camouflage; Katarina's kit has no revealsStealth flag, so a sweeper or Control Ward is the only counter.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Heroic Swing 18s and Avengerang 9s at rank 1 with an explicit wait-then-commit line; dontsFull[0].d states the shield; dosFull[2] pair now covers the sweeper requirement.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shunpo (second use) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
